title: Play it backwards
hints: You don't need any new nodes. Walk the list once and turn each `next` pointer around, so it points at the node *behind* you.
Keep three pointers: `prev` (starts `NULL`), `cur` (starts at `head`) and `next`. Save `cur->next` before you overwrite it, or you lose the rest of the list.
`Song *prev = NULL; while (head != NULL) { Song *next = head->next; head->next = prev; prev = head; head = next; } return prev;`
